title: Markers
description: Adds markers to the locator bar.
body:
# Markers
Adds markers to the locator bar.

### Features
- Adds markers to the global locator bar for all players.
- Completely customiseable with color and style
- Support for custom styles added with resource packs

### Permissions
```marker.create``` - Allows creating markers

```marker.remove``` - Allows removing markers

```marker.edit``` - Allows editing markers

```marker.*``` - Grants all marker permissions

_operator will also grant all marker permissions_

### Commands

```/marker create <name> <viewDistance> <color> [style]```
```/marker remove <name>```
```/marker edit <name> <option> <value>```
